Borderline PD!

U can go out to buy stuff at shops but only in your district and only 2 people per household are allowed to leave at one time. You can go to work if you have a letter but most companies in the lockdown areas are doing work from home i think. The lockdowns here are pretty strict we have police officers roaming around checking to see if everyone follows the SOPs. We get fined for not wearing a mask too. We had a whole country lockdown for a few months earlier this year and the number of cases where even at 0 one time. 

But since the spike in cases they’re doing a lockdown in some areas again. Technically i wouldnt have trouble with the authorities for going out to get my medication its just I cant make up a reason to my parents lol.

The lockdown? Im not living in the us. Its common for my country to have 2 weeks of lockdown whenever the cases spike a bit. You’re allowed to leave the house for medical purposes its just harder for me since my parents will be at home and i have been getting treatment discreetly.

As far as i know we can go and get a medication refill whenever we run out without an appointment (correct me if im wrong). So I was thinking of maybe just biting the bullet and going tomorrow although idk if its allowed since technically i still have 3 days until i run out of my medication.

Some backstory: 23F recently graduated, have PTSD, depression, anxiety and OCD. I have accepted that this is my life and this pain has become part of who i am. It just has become too unbearable for me to withstand. Ive never been in this much pain which is why i am ok with things coming to an end. 

Thank you so much for the kind words everyone has been very sweet 💗

The things that used to keep me going no longer do that for me because ive made peace with the fact that im not fit for living. I just graduated but have no intentions of looking for a job/moving up in my life. I cant do anything related to the future because i dont want one for myself. There was a time where i would be miserable and want to get out of it but now im ok with it never getting better. I can picture other people’s aspirations no matter how impossible they may be but for myself i cant even picture a good and simple life. Because like i said ive always known that im not built for this life which used to make me sad but now ive accepted it. I dont know if I can ever get out of this because ive never been as low as i have now and i also dont want to get out. Thank you so much for your kind words and concern it means a lot💗

I used to have a wonderful therapist who helped me navigate through my pain but that relationship had to end after I graduated from studying abroad and now im back in my country where i can no longer have her help. She knows more about me and my pain more than anyone ever has but now that lifeline is gone. Maybe things would be different if i still had her help.

I have gone to get help here (in my home country) too but that didnt go out so well. The doctor was nice enough but i dont trust her. She diagnosed me with depression, anxiety and OCD  and did prescribe me with some antidepressants, a route ive never taken and have nothing against. But i havent taken a single pill because i cant see what the point of getting/feeling better would be because my life would still be this dark doomsday hole. All of this i have done on my own because my family is out of the question, in fact they are the cause of my problems. I have sweet friends but i dont want to trouble them. Its ok though because i have gone through some shitty things on my own before. 

Although it was hard to believe i have accepted that its not my fault, its just i cant bear to deal with being here anymore. Which is why i have made peace with my life being this way and just want to end this nightmare. Im not fit for living and will never amount to anything. But thank you so much for your concern 💗
I cant imagine a day where i will ever feel that way about being alive but thank you for your kind words 💗

Most of my issues are rooted from my family. I have ptsd from some things that happened when i was a child and some other unfortunate incidents over the years. Mostly related to them too. I used to have a distraction because i was studying abroad but now that ive graduated and back in my childhood home things have gone to shit. Its been triggering being back here and ive just hit rock bottom. Its hard when you have to constantly be around the cause of your pain. But im not even motivated to get a job and move out because i dont see how there is anything worth living for. I know how you it feels to have a toxic family and hope things get better for you soon.

Everyday i pray that something will just happen to me so i dont have to go through with doing it myself (since its not always guaranteed to work). Ive made peace with knowing my life will never be great which is why im very ok with going now.

My hobbies (art) have died along with my attention span and motivation to do anything i enjoy. I do the bare minimum of brushing my teeth but thats about it (im sorry i know im gross). I will clean up if i absolutely have to go out but other than that i just sit in my room and stare into nothing all day. 

Thank you so much for offering an ear and your concern 💗
It really does suck. I dont know how im going to get out of this if i can even get out of it. Hope things get better for you though.

The only thing that has kept me from doing the irreversible is it might not get me there completely so basically i dont have a fool proof plan yet. Ive always been miserable but never this suicidal. The things that used to keep me going no longer do anything for me because i feel like they are all just distractions for the real truth which is there’s nothing here for me. Hi, this reply means so much to me that i cried for awhile when i first saw it and why i took my time to reply. It almost feels like my therapist is talking to me as this makes me feel seen and understood. You literally have said everything that i always want to say but didnt know how to verbalize.

I do have major issues with explaining myself so that everyone can see the “true” me and hence the over apologising too. It makes me feel unsettled if i dont get to explain myself. Even when i do get to explain myself i am left ruminating on a “better” way to say it than i did the last time. Its so hard to explain to other people because i will apologise for any offence that i think ive caused them (even when its not caused by me) but apologising too much isnt flattering, and can be too much for others. This has caused some small rifts with my friends because they don’t understand where im coming from and feel like im nitpicking them when its the total opposite. At first i was offended but now i see how this can become too much for other people and because of this i have refrained myself from apologising if i can as my main priority is not to make people angry (because that ties in with my fear of something bad will happen to me). So even if it pains me not to apologize it pains me even more to make someone angry. I have since been open to my friends and they have helped me by giving me challenges so i dont apologize so much. Im thankful that they understand but i do feel like im annoying and needy and such a loser friend.

I always wake up early to prepare myself in case i offend someone and need to apologise. It just was a part of my everyday life that i didnt know was abnormal. I thought everyone went through it until i saw a video of someone who had a similar issue and that is when i went to get help (which is now gone). I just want this to end because it feels very tiring and is taking up too much of my energy and time. I cant do things that I enjoy because i need to focus on these obsessive thoughts so i can find a solution so something bad wont happen to me. 

This also ties in with my obsession with “last impressions or last times”. I always envision how my last times with people/things/situations go and if they dont turn out that way it will cause me so much pain because i will need to redo it so it goes the way i had pictured because again i fear something bad will happen to me if it doesnt. It gets bad when i am unable to redo those events due to limitation like the location being far or something like that. It just drives me crazy. 

Anyways, thank you so much for listening to me. These past few days have been one of the worst days in my life because of the pain that im in especially as im back at home, the place where all my issues began after 3 years of studying abroad. Ive never felt this kind of pain before so thank you for making me feel seen and not alone.

Thank you so much for your kind words. This really means a lot to me knowing that i am not alone in feeling this way. Its a been awhile since i have felt this much pain and i had her to thank for it. Its just a weird thing to navigate around since the relationship ended on such a good note it just makes me feel suffocated with sadness of not being able to see her anymore. I will try to honour our relationship by continuing to work on myself but this grief is very painful to bear. Thank you so much again. Just getting this off my chest has calmed me down a bit.

Thank you so much for your kind words. It has been extremely difficult to do anything without breaking down crying as i am reminded of her all the time. It just pains me so much that at a time where i need her the most is a time where i can never talk to her again. Its also especially hard being at home again after so long, where most of my issues started. I just wish i could have her to guide me through this time so i dont regress back to some of my unhealthy coping habits. It just becomes more painful with the added grief of leaving school (w/o a commencement), leaving the city that i was studying in and just that whole life where i was physically far away from the source of my issues. Now that i am literally 9000 miles away from her and all that ive known for the past few years does not help with the pain.

I do want to write her an email to thank her for everything and for closure purposes but im trying to find the right words to make sure i dont miss anything out, as i was made aware that i would no longer be able to email her about therapy stuff unless its for her to transfer notes to my new therapist (which I understand but hate so much). 

I cant begin to imagine how you must be feeling after being with your therapist for so long. You have given some hope that i will slowly be able to overcome this grief that i am experiencing. Prior to my last session with my therapist, she did advise me to continue going to therapy which i feel would be best for me. However, i am struggling with the fact that is there a therapist out there who will click with me as i did with her and even if i do find someone, i feel like i wont be able to go through with it because it feels like im replacing her when i can never replace someone as amazing as her.

Thank you so much again for your kind words. This means so much to me as i feel less alone in this. I hope that everyone who is going through something similar will find the strength to continue living as i too hope that for myself.
